STATEMENT OF OBJECTS AND REASONS
Act 41 of 2013.- The A.H. Memorial Educational Trust, have come forward to establish
private University in the State.

The establishment of a private university by a well-known

organization would certainly help in spreading the quality education to the needy students. This
also accelerates the enhancement of gross enrolment ratio in the higher education sector which
presently stands at 11.5% in Karnataka.
Keeping in view the above, it is considered necessary to provide for establishment of
Presidency University.
This private University focuses on Business and Management Studies, Life Sciences,
Computer Science & Information Technology and other Technical courses, Medical Sciences and
allied sectors and for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
Hence, the Bill.
[L.C. Bill No.04 of 2013, File No. Samvyashae 11 Shasana 2013]
[Entry 25 of List III of the Seventh Schedule to the Constitution of India.]
